html.en:
Thank you for your interest in marketing Aetna Medicare and SilverScript through Hero Insurance USA. Aetna uses an online contracting system and we will need some information to get the process started.

To get started, contact María Lo Monaco at contractingsupport@heroinsuranceusa.com and request the Carrier Request Form to begin your Aetna contracting. After you return the form, you will receive an invitation with a link to begin contracting in a few days. Click on the link to begin.

You will receive an invitation email from AetnaMedicare@aetna.com. The subject line will read: “You have been invited to contract with Aetna Medicare!”
You will then be asked if you already have access to the Aetna Producer World. If you do not, you will be asked to register. After you are registered for Producer World, click back on the contracting link and log in using your username and password.

If you cannot find your invitation email or are taken to the Producer World home page https://www.aetna.com/producer/login, navigate to Individual Medicare → Quick Links → Medicare Producer Contracting. You will be prompted to complete your contract. Go to Open Cases and complete the contract. You will receive an on-screen confirmation of submission.

If you have multiple invites, you will need to cancel all but one to move forward.

Upon login to Producer World, your records will be pulled from the National Insurance Producer Registry. Be sure to update your personal and firm information with the National Insurance Producer Registry: https://nipr.com/licensing-center/change-contact-info.

Aetna will then ask if you are contracting as an agency. Select YES if you are the principal of your own corporation. Select NO if you are not.

You will then review and sign your W-9. Complete required fields and select the blue “Click to Sign” button.

Continue and select the invitation.

Now you will work your way through each contracting tab. Fill in all mandatory fields. The tab will show “incomplete” if information is missing. Note the final Transfer tab — this is where you will upload your Aetna transfer form if you are moving from a different upline agency. This is NOT required if you are contracting with Aetna for the first time.

If you are already contracted you will need to complete the Aetna Transfer Release form (request the current version from contractingsupport@heroinsuranceusa.com). If your current upline signs it, you will transfer immediately. If the form is not signed by your upline, upload it with only your signature and you will be realigned after a 90-day waiting period. No transfers can be made between 10/1 and 12/31.

After all tabs have been completed, submit the contract for processing. You will receive a confirmation of submission. You can immediately begin Aetna certification.

IMPORTANT: Your contract will NOT be processed until certification is complete.

Upon completion of your contract and yearly certification, you will be appointed by Aetna for Individual Medicare products in the pre-appointing states where they hold an active license. Just-in-time appointing states will be ordered after a policy is written.
html.es:
Gracias por tu interés en comercializar Aetna Medicare y SilverScript a través de Hero Insurance USA. Aetna usa un sistema de contracting en línea y necesitaremos algunos datos para iniciar el proceso.

Para empezar, contacta a María Lo Monaco a contractingsupport@heroinsuranceusa.com y solicita el formulario de Carrier Request para iniciar tu contracting con Aetna. Una vez que devuelvas el formulario, recibirás en pocos días una invitación con un enlace para comenzar. Haz click en el enlace para iniciar.

Vas a recibir un correo de invitación desde AetnaMedicare@aetna.com. El asunto dirá: “You have been invited to contract with Aetna Medicare!”
Después te preguntará si ya tienes acceso a Aetna Producer World. Si no lo tienes, te pedirá registrarte. Una vez registrado en Producer World, regresa al enlace de contracting y accede con tu usuario y contraseña.

Si no encuentras el correo de invitación o si aterrizas en la página principal de Producer World https://www.aetna.com/producer/login, navega a Individual Medicare → Quick Links → Medicare Producer Contracting. Se te pedirá completar tu contrato. Ve a Open Cases y completa el contrato. Verás una confirmación en pantalla al enviarlo.

Si tienes varias invitaciones, deberás cancelar todas menos una para poder continuar.

Al ingresar a Producer World, tus registros se traerán desde el National Insurance Producer Registry (NIPR). Asegúrate de tener tu información personal y de la firma actualizadas en NIPR: https://nipr.com/licensing-center/change-contact-info.

Luego, Aetna te preguntará si estás contratando como agencia. Selecciona YES si eres el principal de tu propia corporación. Selecciona NO si no lo eres.

Después revisarás y firmarás tu W-9. Completa los campos obligatorios y presiona el botón azul “Click to Sign”.

Continúa y selecciona la invitación.

Ahora vas a avanzar por cada pestaña del contracting. Completa todos los campos obligatorios. La pestaña mostrará “incomplete” si falta información. Fíjate en la última pestaña Transfer — ahí es donde subes tu formulario de transferencia de Aetna si vienes de otra agencia upline. NO es requerida si es la primera vez que contratas con Aetna.

Si ya estás contratado, deberás completar el formulario Aetna Transfer Release (solicita la versión actual a contractingsupport@heroinsuranceusa.com). Si tu upline actual lo firma, la transferencia es inmediata. Si el upline no lo firma, súbelo solo con tu firma y serás realineado tras un período de espera de 90 días. No se procesan transferencias entre el 10/1 y el 12/31.

Cuando todas las pestañas estén completas, envía el contrato para procesamiento. Recibirás una confirmación de envío. Puedes iniciar la certificación de Aetna de inmediato.

IMPORTANTE: tu contrato NO se procesará hasta que la certificación esté completa.

Al completar tu contrato y la certificación anual, Aetna te appointeará para productos de Individual Medicare en los pre-appointing states donde tengas licencia activa. Los just-in-time appointing states se ordenarán después de que escribas una póliza.

html.en:
Transfers are not permitted or processed from October 1 – December 31. The last day to submit a notice of intent for the current year’s AEP is June 30th.

If you are currently contracted, have been with your current upline for at least three months AND have no production in the last three months, you may submit a new contract. Follow the instructions above for new contracting.

If you are contracted less than three months or have had production in the last three months, you will need to complete a new contract and upload the Aetna Transfer Release form (request the current form from contractingsupport@heroinsuranceusa.com).

If your upline will not sign the Transfer form, begin a notice of intent by completing all the way to the agent portion of the Transfer form. The completed transfer must be submitted electronically via Medicare Producer Contracting inside Producer World: Producer World → Medicare Producer Contracting → open assigned invitation → Add Document → Upload transfer or intent to transfer. Once submitted, you will be transferred to Hero after a 3-month interim period.
html.es:
Las transferencias no se procesan del 1 de octubre al 31 de diciembre. La última fecha para enviar un notice of intent para el AEP del año en curso es el 30 de junio.

Si estás contratado actualmente, llevas al menos tres meses con tu upline Y no tuviste producción en los últimos tres meses, puedes enviar un nuevo contrato. Sigue las instrucciones de arriba para nuevo contracting.

Si llevas menos de tres meses contratado o tuviste producción en los últimos tres meses, tendrás que completar un contrato nuevo y subir el formulario Aetna Transfer Release (solicita el formulario vigente a contractingsupport@heroinsuranceusa.com).

Si tu upline no firma el Transfer form, inicia un notice of intent completando el formulario hasta la parte del agente. La transferencia se envía por vía electrónica desde Medicare Producer Contracting dentro de Producer World: Producer World → Medicare Producer Contracting → abrir la invitación asignada → Add Document → subir el transfer o intent to transfer. Una vez enviada, serás transferido a Hero después de un período interino de 3 meses.

html.en:
You should actively monitor your RTS (Ready-To-Sell) status before selling in each state where you conduct business. You can monitor your active RTS status on Aetna’s Individual Medicare page under Requirements to sell on Producer World https://www.aetna.com/about-us/login.html. The interactive map lets an agent or agency principal determine their RTS status by product and by state, specific to the selling season.

To add a state, email brokersupport@aetna.com including your name, NPN, non-resident license, and the state you would like to be contracted in.

Some state appointments are processed just-in-time; others need an appointment prior to submitting business. If you need Aetna’s Pre-Appointment State List, request the current version from contractingsupport@heroinsuranceusa.com.
html.es:
Debes monitorear activamente tu status RTS (Ready-To-Sell) antes de vender en cada estado donde operas. Puedes ver tu status RTS en la página de Individual Medicare de Aetna, bajo Requirements to sell, dentro de Producer World https://www.aetna.com/about-us/login.html. El mapa interactivo permite a un agente o principal de agencia determinar su status RTS por producto y estado, específico de la selling season.

Para agregar un estado, envía un email a brokersupport@aetna.com incluyendo tu nombre, NPN, licencia non-resident y el estado en el que quieres estar contratado.

Algunos appointments de estado se procesan just-in-time; otros requieren appointment previo antes de someter negocio. Si necesitas la Pre-Appointment State List de Aetna, solicita la versión vigente a contractingsupport@heroinsuranceusa.com.

html.en:
Agents can only assign commissions to themselves or to a broker-owned agency. Aetna allows for one agent-principal per broker-owned agency.

If you need to assign commissions to a third party, there are two options:

  1. Contract as an LOA under Hero. Hero will pay agent commission in accordance with the assignment of commission on file.
  2. Update the agent’s EFT to pay the third party. The agent will get the 1099 at year-end, but the third party’s accountant can transfer that to the third party with a form.
html.es:
Los agentes solo pueden asignar comisiones a sí mismos o a una agencia broker-owned. Aetna permite un agente-principal por cada agencia broker-owned.

Si necesitas asignar comisiones a un tercero, hay dos opciones:

  1. Contratar como LOA bajo Hero. Hero pagará la comisión del agente según la asignación de comisiones que quede en archivo.
  2. Actualizar el EFT del agente para pagar al tercero. El agente recibirá el 1099 a fin de año, pero el contador del tercero puede transferirlo con un formulario.

html.en:
To begin your transfer with Ambetter, first determine who your current upline is. If you are contracted with Ambetter and want to move to Hero through Plan Advisors, request the current Ambetter Direct Producer Release form from contractingsupport@heroinsuranceusa.com.

Forms should be submitted to Ambetterbrokers@centene.com. Please CC contractingsupport@heroinsuranceusa.com and info@myplanadvisors.com on the email request.

NOTE: Agents currently direct with Ambetter only need the Sub-Producer signature (not the Principal & Agency).

Timeframe: Requests are generally processed within 15 business days.

Ambetter reserves the right to deny this request. Ambetter does not, under any circumstances, transfer membership or commissions.

Any commissions and membership the sub-producer earned under the previous contracted agency & principal will remain there — nothing transfers to the new contracting entity. No exceptions.

Upon completion, the agent needs to recontract.

There is no delayed release process. The blackout period varies year to year and is determined by Ambetter.
html.es:
Para iniciar tu transferencia con Ambetter, primero identifica quién es tu upline actual. Si estás contratado con Ambetter y quieres moverte a Hero a través de Plan Advisors, solicita el Ambetter Direct Producer Release form vigente a contractingsupport@heroinsuranceusa.com.

Los formularios se envían a Ambetterbrokers@centene.com. Incluye en CC a contractingsupport@heroinsuranceusa.com y a info@myplanadvisors.com.

NOTA: los agentes actualmente directos con Ambetter solo necesitan la firma del Sub-Producer (no la del Principal ni la Agencia).

Tiempo estimado: las solicitudes se procesan generalmente en 15 días hábiles.

Ambetter se reserva el derecho de denegar la solicitud. Ambetter no transfiere membership ni comisiones bajo ninguna circunstancia.

Toda comisión y membership que el sub-producer haya ganado bajo la agencia y principal anteriores se queda ahí — nada se transfiere a la nueva entidad de contracting. Sin excepciones.

Al completar el proceso, el agente debe recontratar.

No hay proceso de liberación diferida. El período de blackout varía año con año y lo determina Ambetter.

html.en:
Thank you for your interest in marketing Anthem Blue Cross & Amerigroup through Hero Insurance USA. Anthem uses an online contracting system and we will need some information to get the process started.

To get started, contact María Lo Monaco at contractingsupport@heroinsuranceusa.com and request the Carrier Request Form to begin your Anthem contracting. After returning the form you will receive an invitation with a link to begin contracting in a few days.

The Anthem email will come from software.support@anthem.com with the subject “Action Required: Your agency has asked us to appoint you”. The body of the email will indicate that the invite was sent by Hero Insurance USA.

If logging in using the link in the email notification from SoftwareSupport@anthem.com, once logged in you will land directly in the appointment request. If logging in by going to https://brokerportal.anthem.com/apps/ptb/login, click the Complete Appointment button.

Basic Information — If Contracting as a Corporation: The agency information section will only appear if you select ‘yes’ to indicate you are the Principal of an Agency or General Agency. If you are not the principal of the agency, select ‘no’ and you will not be prompted to enter agency information.

Appointment Section: Select the state/brand combinations you want to be appointed/contracted in. Select Line of Business — most states have Individual, Large Group, Small Group and Senior. Select one option, then click Add another Line of Business to add more. Select who your Medicare commissions should be paid to. When contracting as a corporation, both you and your corporation need to be licensed in all requested states.

To sell Medicare with Hero, it is critical to select the Senior line of business.

  • Commission selection — state selection needs to be complete to view all options:
    • Broker — direct pay to agent
    • Parent Agency — commissions paid to Hero, and Hero pays you
    • 3 Tier Broker Owned Agency — commission paid to the corporation you own
    • 3 Tier Agency (not common) — you are assigning your Anthem/Amerigroup commissions to a third party currently contracted with Anthem

If a release is required due to an existing agency relationship, you will see the release information message. If a release is not required, you will not see it.

Complete the business survey, forms, EFT, and payment. Payment of state appointment fees is required if you are contracting for the first time in that state. Fees are set by each state’s Department of Insurance.

When completed, you will see a submission confirmation. You can check the status of your request on your dashboard.

You may now begin the certification process. You can complete the certification while your contract is being processed — instructions are in your back-office portal. After the contract is processed and certification completes successfully, you will receive an Anthem “Welcome” letter with your agent number.
html.es:
Gracias por tu interés en comercializar Anthem Blue Cross y Amerigroup a través de Hero Insurance USA. Anthem usa un sistema de contracting en línea y necesitaremos algunos datos para iniciar.

Para empezar, contacta a María Lo Monaco a contractingsupport@heroinsuranceusa.com y solicita el Carrier Request Form para iniciar tu contracting con Anthem. Una vez que devuelvas el formulario recibirás en pocos días una invitación con un enlace para comenzar.

El email de Anthem vendrá desde software.support@anthem.com con el asunto “Action Required: Your agency has asked us to appoint you”. El cuerpo del email indicará que la invitación fue enviada por Hero Insurance USA.

Si accedes por el link del email de SoftwareSupport@anthem.com, aterrizas directo en el appointment request. Si accedes desde https://brokerportal.anthem.com/apps/ptb/login, presiona el botón Complete Appointment.

Información básica — si contratas como corporación: la sección de información de la agencia solo aparece si seleccionas ‘yes’ indicando que eres el Principal de una agencia o General Agency. Si no eres el principal, selecciona ‘no’ y no te pedirá los datos de la agencia.

Sección de appointment: selecciona las combinaciones de estado/marca donde quieres estar appointeado/contratado. Selecciona Line of Business — la mayoría de los estados tienen Individual, Large Group, Small Group y Senior. Selecciona una opción, luego presiona Add another Line of Business para agregar más. Elige a quién se pagan tus comisiones de Medicare. Al contratar como corporación, tanto tú como tu corporación deben tener licencia en todos los estados solicitados.

Para vender Medicare con Hero es fundamental seleccionar la línea Senior.

  • Selección de comisión — la selección de estado tiene que estar completa para ver todas las opciones:
    • Broker — pago directo al agente
    • Parent Agency — las comisiones se pagan a Hero, y Hero te paga a ti
    • 3 Tier Broker Owned Agency — la comisión se paga a la corporación que tú posees
    • 3 Tier Agency (poco común) — asignas tus comisiones de Anthem/Amerigroup a un tercero que ya está contratado con Anthem

Si se requiere release por una relación de agencia existente, verás el mensaje de release information. Si no se requiere, no lo verás.

Completa el business survey, los formularios, el EFT y el pago. El pago de state appointment fees se requiere si es la primera vez que contratas en ese estado. Las tarifas las fija el Department of Insurance de cada estado.

Al completar verás una confirmación de envío. Puedes revisar el estatus de tu solicitud en tu dashboard.

Ya puedes iniciar el proceso de certificación. Puedes hacer la certificación mientras se procesa el contrato — las instrucciones están en el portal back-office. Cuando el contrato termine de procesarse y la certificación sea exitosa, recibirás una carta de bienvenida de Anthem con tu número de agente.

html.en:
If you are currently contracted with Anthem through another agency, you will need to submit a new agent contract under Hero using the instructions above.

Two ways to transfer to Hero:

Immediate transfer: submit your Hero/Anthem contract and upload your letter of release from your previous agency. Reach out to your current upline to see if they will issue a letter of release. If no release is uploaded, you default to the three-month delayed release.

Three-month delayed release: submit your Hero/Anthem contract. After three months you will need to send a new Hero/Anthem contract. Anthem will send you an email notifying that the three months have passed. Forward that email to contractingsupport@heroinsuranceusa.com and we will send you a new contracting link. Agents submitting for delayed release between 7/1 and 9/1 can submit their second contract after 1/1.

Agents can continue to sell Anthem whether their upline agency honors the request for immediate release or requires a waiting period.

Elevance Health Agent Release Policy

Agents currently associated with an FMO/EMO/MGA partner must be released before changing their relationship. When an onboarding request is received for a new relationship and the agent is identified as having an active affiliation with an FMO/EMO/MGA partner, a release request is generated online via the Broker Portal to the current partner.

IF the release is approved: the new onboarding request moves forward and completes processing. No waiting or blackout period applies.

IF the release is denied: the current onboarding request is closed and a waiting period is required before the agent can re-apply.

Blackout Period for Agent Release:

  • Upline agency denial of release requests submitted between January 2 and June 30 — waiting period of 90 days.
  • Upline agency denial of release requests submitted between July 1 and September 30 — subject to AEP blackout. Agents can re-apply starting January 2.
  • A limit of one release every 12 months is accepted for all agents without approval from the current upline agency (subject to waiting periods).

Why the blackout and 90-day release option? This protects Anthem’s agency partners during the most critical months before and during AEP. The 90-day release option gives agents more flexibility. Downline agents can continue selling Anthem whether their upline honors immediate release or requires a waiting period.

Agent Release Timeline
Release request receivedIf not approved: waiting periodIf approved: immediate release
1/2 through 6/30Re-apply after 90-day waiting periodProcessed upon receipt*
Blackout Period — 7/1 through 9/30Re-apply beginning 1/2Processed upon receipt*
10/1 through 1/1Re-apply after 90-day waiting periodProcessed upon receipt*

*Upon validation by the Licensing & Credentialing Team.
html.es:
Si actualmente estás contratado con Anthem a través de otra agencia, deberás enviar un nuevo agent contract bajo Hero siguiendo las instrucciones de arriba.

Dos formas de transferirte a Hero:

Transferencia inmediata: envía tu contrato Hero/Anthem y sube tu letter of release de la agencia anterior. Contacta a tu upline actual para que emita el release. Si no subes el release, cae por defecto al delayed release de tres meses.

Delayed release de tres meses: envía tu contrato Hero/Anthem. A los tres meses tendrás que enviar un nuevo contrato Hero/Anthem. Anthem te enviará un email notificando que pasaron los tres meses. Reenvíalo a contractingsupport@heroinsuranceusa.com y te enviaremos un nuevo enlace de contracting. Los agentes que soliciten delayed release entre el 7/1 y el 9/1 pueden enviar su segundo contrato después del 1/1.

Los agentes pueden seguir vendiendo Anthem sin importar si su upline aprueba la liberación inmediata o requiere el waiting period.

Elevance Health Agent Release Policy

Los agentes actualmente asociados con un partner FMO/EMO/MGA deben ser liberados antes de cambiar de relación. Cuando se recibe una solicitud de onboarding para una nueva relación y el agente tiene afiliación activa con un partner FMO/EMO/MGA, se genera una release request en línea vía el Broker Portal hacia el partner actual.

SI el release es aprobado: la nueva solicitud de onboarding avanza y completa el procesamiento. No aplica waiting period ni blackout.

SI el release es denegado: la solicitud actual se cierra y se requiere un waiting period antes de que el agente pueda re-aplicar.

Blackout Period para Agent Release:

  • Denegación del upline entre el 2 de enero y el 30 de junio — waiting period de 90 días.
  • Denegación del upline entre el 1 de julio y el 30 de septiembre — sujeto al blackout de AEP. Los agentes pueden re-aplicar a partir del 2 de enero.
  • Límite de un release cada 12 meses para todos los agentes sin aprobación del upline actual (sujeto a waiting periods).

¿Por qué el blackout y la opción de release de 90 días? Esto protege a las agencias partner de Anthem en los meses más críticos antes y durante el AEP. La opción de 90 días le da flexibilidad al agente. Los downline agents pueden seguir vendiendo Anthem tanto si su upline aprueba la liberación inmediata como si requiere waiting period.
